title_es: Red judicial, comunitaria y de propiedad no-LPB/Matkator
title_en: Non-LPB/Matkator court, Community and ownership network
purpose_es: Conectar por ID, fuente, fecha, capacidad y límite a demandantes propietarios, perímetro residual, representantes y continuidad posterior, sin convertir la conexión en culpabilidad colectiva.
purpose_en: Connect claimant-owners, the residual-owner perimeter, representatives and later continuity by ID, source, date, capacity and limitation without turning connection into collective culpability.
boundaries: AP 89/2014 identifies exactly seven claimant-owners of 18 bungalows; it does not identify every non-LPB/Matkator owner as a claimant.
The wider Montelanza/Molina perimeter derives from party pleadings and Community records and remains separately graded.
A family, company, professional, representation or chronology link does not transfer knowledge, intention, control, benefit or liability.
The 4 February 2022 ACTA used here is a controlled source copy, not a certified or diligenced minute-book original.
Additional natural persons appearing only in pleadings remain outside the public dataset pending person-specific admission and privacy review.

layers.title_es: JV 1260/2011 y AP 89/2014 — siete demandantes propietarios
layers.summary_es: AP 89/2014 identifica exactamente siete demandantes/apelantes propietarios de 18 bungalows. La sentencia revocó parcialmente y ordenó el desalojo de Monterecco respecto de los apartamentos demandantes.
layers.summary_en: AP 89/2014 identifies exactly seven claimant/appellant owners of 18 bungalows. The judgment partially reversed and ordered Monterecco's eviction from the claimant apartments.

layers.title_es: Perímetro residual Montelanza/Molina y otros propietarios
layers.summary_es: Perímetro más amplio que los siete demandantes. La cifra aproximada del 23% y la caracterización familia Molina/minoritarios son posiciones de parte que exigen reconstrucción finca por finca.
layers.summary_en: A wider perimeter than the seven claimants. The approximate 23% figure and Molina-family/minority-owner description are party positions requiring unit-by-unit reconstruction.

layers.title_es: Órgano, poderes, deuda y voto de 2011
layers.summary_es: Separa la junta de 2 de febrero del eje controvertido de 22 de junio. La validez de poderes, deuda, voto y autoridad permanece discutida.
layers.summary_en: Separates the 2 February meeting from the contested 22 June sequence. The validity of powers, debt, voting and authority remains disputed.

layers.summary_es: Registra representación declarada, circulación documental y conocimiento contemporáneo sin inferir transmisión total ni acuerdo común.
layers.summary_en: Records stated representation, document circulation and contemporaneous knowledge without inferring total transmission or a common agreement.

layers.summary_es: Distingue decisiones de seguridad, acceso, llaves, ejecución material y declaraciones. Probar qué se dijo no prueba por sí solo legalidad, autoridad o concertación.
layers.summary_en: Separates security decisions, access, keys, material implementation and statements. Proving what was said does not itself prove legality, authority or concert.

layers.summary_es: La copia controlada del ACTA registra capacidades Acosta Matos, el proyecto y la explicación de saldos solicitada por Manuel Molina Climent. No es el original diligenciado del libro de actas.
layers.summary_en: The controlled ACTA copy records Acosta Matos capacities, the project and the balance explanation requested by Manuel Molina Climent. It is not the diligenced minute-book original.

layers.title_es: Familia y negocio Acosta Matos — etapa posterior
layers.title_en: Acosta Matos family and business — later stage
layers.summary_es: Agrupa visualmente a José Daniel, Laura Patricia, Gerardo Zacarías y Javier, pero cada cargo, sociedad, poder, firma, fecha y acto se atribuye por separado.
layers.summary_en: Visually groups José Daniel, Laura Patricia, Gerardo Zacarías and Javier while attributing every office, company, power, signature, date and act separately.

relationships.limitation_es: La representación profesional no convierte al letrado en propietario ni prueba coordinación ilícita.
relationships.limitation_en: Professional representation does not make counsel an owner or prove unlawful coordination.

relationships.proposition_es: La reconstrucción de la parte denunciante individualiza su voto en la junta de 2 de febrero de 2011.
relationships.proposition_en: The complainant-side reconstruction individualises her vote at the 2 February 2011 meeting.
relationships.limitation_es: No es una conclusión judicial sobre intención, validez o culpabilidad.
relationships.limitation_en: It is not a judicial finding on intent, validity or culpability.

relationships.proposition_es: La copia del ACTA registra que estuvo presente y que, a petición suya, se explicó el origen de los saldos deudores antes de la aprobación.
relationships.proposition_en: The ACTA copy records that he was present and, at his request, the origin of debtor balances was explained before approval.
relationships.limitation_es: Pedir explicación no equivale a crear, verificar independientemente o aprobar originalmente la deuda.
relationships.limitation_en: Requesting an explanation is not creating, independently verifying or originally approving the debt.

relationships.limitation_es: Razón social, NIF, poder, fincas, coeficiente y voto exactos permanecen abiertos.
relationships.limitation_en: Exact legal entity, NIF, power, units, coefficient and vote remain open.

relationships.proposition_es: Gerardo Zacarías Acosta Matos es persona distinta de Gerardo Nicanor Acosta Armas.
relationships.proposition_en: Gerardo Zacarías Acosta Matos is a different person from Gerardo Nicanor Acosta Armas.
